snippet.title: Renaissance : Chapter 1 - IS OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Chapter 1: " A Glimmer Over Alidiris " IS OUT NOW! 

📍GET IT HERE :
https://api.pkmnrenaissance.com/launcher/release 

Get ready to step into the world of Project Renaissance and begin your journey throughout the Aldiris region! Discover new characters, encounter brand-new Pokémon species, explore new locations created from scratch, and uncover what awaits you in the first chapter of your adventure. We've been working hard to bring this world to life, and we can't wait for you to experience it for yourselves ! 

Follow us on social media to stay up to date with Project Renaissance and everything that's coming next! 

Thank you for watching and enjoy Chapter 1!
